text: Make an 8-second, 16:9 landscape ad for ClearDay, a fictional app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Use a calm blue-and-white look with no sound or voiceover. Any other wording is up to you, in English. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
